## P1.3 — Exact listing visibility

P1.3 implementation and declared validation complete. Both Major review findings repaired; focused Grok recheck has zero findings. Owner authorized the Vue scope extension.

- One pure `AclFolder` folds nearest-first grants for individual and batch resolution.
- `evaluateMany` groups storage/owner lanes, resolves subjects once, loads ancestor chains with one storage-scoped, cycle-guarded CTE, and reads grants once.
- `ExactListing` scans candidates to the configured budget, retains the last inspected key, and signs cursors bound to query and order. `NodePage` carries items/continuation/scanned.
- HTTP children/search/trash/shared and folder children apply effective View; batch grants populate resource abilities. Filament filters actual fetched table records and uses simple pagination.
- Config, upgrade/changelog, authorization/search docs, exception anchor and public API golden updated.
